classification: Post-hoc descriptive reporting completion from existing immutable originals, not a new preregistration, hypothesis test, or research execution
coverage: Every existing completed run, no outcome-based exclusions. Read only start/terminal/audit metadata and existing native run.json members; hash complete archives and verify original Git identities. Do not execute project models, selectors, inference, captures, RNG or unrun nonce files.

metrics.offered_delivered_unserved_deficit: Preserve the four native summary/audit quantities and SI units, check offered minus delivered equals unserved; do not rerun integrations.
metrics.labor_and_tools: Report actual travel, work, wait, access-check and tool time separately. Paid=travel+work+wait; access/rendezvous/queue are already included in wait.
metrics.completed_inspections_and_interventions: Copy verified original audit counts and preserve task dispositions; completion is not confirmation or closure.
metrics.unconfirmed_or_aborted_work: Separate last actual work dispositions (aborted/rejected/nonterminal) from existing inspection feedback UNCONFIRMED and from unverified risk. No combined false-negative count.
metrics.selector_and_model_evaluations: Use only original policy_computation_audit counters; report selection instants, model-call counters and structural checks separately.
metrics.wall_compute_time: Sum original elapsed_ns; diagnostic wall seconds only, never physical response time or a field latency estimate.
metrics.provenance_valid_confirmation: Read InspectionSession's existing NAMED_SIGNAL_THRESHOLD_ONLY_NOT_FAULT_DIAGNOSIS feedback. Match task/record/source/target/observable/provenance and actual sample/completion clocks, require additional_evidence_factor false. Report historical arrived threshold findings and endpoint-current findings separately; use unique task-record pairs, not feedback as additional evidence. The denominator is actual arrived inspection feedback/issued inspection tasks, explicitly shown. Generic fault confirmation remains NOT_OPERATIONALIZED.
metrics.misleading_reports_by_declared_world_tru: Report NOT_OPERATIONALIZED when no frozen rule links the operator cue to actual vibration truth. A family label or healthy filter is not a per-record truth label. Numeric declared-bound containment can be reported as a separate quality diagnostic, never substituted for false-alarm rate.
metrics.missed_distinguishable_reports: Report NOT_OPERATIONALIZED_NO_FROZEN_OPPORTUNITY_DENOMINATOR; not inspecting a candidate is not automatically a miss. Preserve raw public opportunities as an index only, without a new counterfactual selector.
metrics.actual_effect_vs_public_verified_closure: Report original APPLIED effects separately. Where native closure_program is null, verified closure is NOT_EVALUATED_WITHOUT_POST_ACTION_PROTOCOL, not zero.
metrics.timing_descriptives: For existing actual inspections report issued, arrival at site, work start/end, observed and public report arrival timestamps, plus issue-to-report and measurement-to-report delays. Conditional on the actually selected/arrived tasks; no causal method ranking or site-time transfer.
metrics.pre_failure_early_detection: NOT_TESTED_NO_FROZEN_PRECURSOR_ENDPOINT. Do not infer pre-failure benefit from arrival or a family name. Distinguish the existing compressed10s comparison from field inspection time and the100s finite value witness.

primary_result_rule: Original primary pairs, original denominators, sources, thresholds and NO_PRACTICAL_GAIN stay immutable. Supplemental descriptive counts cannot create a new gain category.
delivery: phase/method descriptive summaries with explicit denominators
saved-only attempt record and terminal receipt
short report and independent saved-data review
execution_gate: Pin extraction tool and this plan in Git, with unique output directory and attempt record, before aggregate extraction. Keep failures; no automatic retry or overwrite.
